# Event 1O1
> Event 1O1 is a full-service event management and production company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, founded by Nikhil Sharma (DJ Nikhil Ahmedabad). The company provides wedding, corporate, festive and destination event services across Gujarat and selected destinations in India.

## Company Information
- Founded by: Nikhil Sharma (DJ Nikhil Ahmedabad)
- Location: 321, 3rd Floor, Palladium Business Hub, Opp. 4D Mall, Visat Gandhinagar Road, Motera, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380005
- Phone: +91 95379 68007
- Email: contact@event1o1.com
- Website: [Event 1O1](https://www.event1o1.com): Official website.
- GST: 24CKPPS1366C1ZX
- Google Rating: 5.0 Stars
- Experience: 7+ years of live event production
- Events: 500+ successful events across Gujarat and Rajasthan
- Instagram: [Event 1O1 Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/event_1_o_1/)
- YouTube: [Event 1O1 YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Event_1O1)
